name: ai-vs-human-checker (Litmus's predecessor)
params: ModernBERT-base encoder plus a 26.8M pair head and a 32,768-passage bank per class
input_limit: passages scored one at a time; see the model card
score_reading: ai_text_checker.checker.load_checker().readings(texts)[i].score
gain: The baseline Litmus must beat; same training family, so any gain is attributable to Litmus itself.

name: Binoculars (Falcon-7B observer, Falcon-7B-instruct performer)
score_reading: perplexity(performer) / cross-perplexity(observer, performer); lower means AI, so the adapter returns its negative
gain: Strongest training-free detector in the RAID and DetectRL tables; no training data, so no benchmark overlap.

name: Desklib AI Text Detector v1.01
score_reading: sigmoid of the single logit
gain: Best open-weight detector with a RAID leaderboard entry among widely used ones (0.912 TPR at 5% FPR, all attacks).

name: Fast-DetectGPT (analytic, Falcon-7B-instruct scoring and sampling)
input_limit: the reference script does not truncate; the adapter truncates to 512 tokens
score_reading: analytic sampling discrepancy; higher means AI
gain: Second widely cited zero-shot method; one model when sampling and scoring share it. The repo reports Llama-3-8B pairs work better (README, 2026-01-31).

name: e5-small-lora
score_reading: softmax index 1 (LABEL_1 is AI per the card)
gain: Smallest open detector with a RAID entry (0.857); anchors the low end of the accuracy-per-cost figure. Trained on RAID train.

name: OpenAI RoBERTa-base detector
score_reading: softmax index 0 ('Fake')
gain: The classic baseline every benchmark reports, so it ties our numbers to theirs.

name: RADAR (RoBERTa-large)
score_reading: softmax index 0 is the AI probability (IBM/RADAR README)
gain: Adversarially trained against a paraphraser; the reference point for paraphrase robustness.

name: ModernBERT RAID+MAGE (Drayson)
score_reading: softmax index 1 (card)
gain: Same base as Litmus's predecessor, trained on RAID and MAGE: shows what supervision alone buys on the in-distribution sets.

name: MAGE Longformer
score_reading: softmax index 0 (label 0 is machine in MAGE)
gain: In-distribution reference on MAGE; trained on MAGE train, so only its OOD sets are fair.

name: SuperAnnotate AI detector
score_reading: sigmoid of one logit through the vendor package generated_text_detector v1.1.0
gain: Low: RAID 0.649 and a custom license and package.

name: EditLens RoBERTa-large
score_reading: not verified (gated card)
adapter: none until the card is read
gain: The only open model built for AI-edited text; matters for Litmus's mixed origin. Gated: accept terms first.

name: RoBERTa ChatGPT (HC3)
score_reading: softmax index 1 ('ChatGPT')
gain: Low: trained on HC3 only (RAID 0.266).

name: Pangram
score_reading: max_ai_likelihood (float) and posteriors for Human, AI-Assisted, AI-Generated (docs)
gain: Top or tied for top among commercial detectors in RAID Task 3, Russell et al. and BFI (independently scored).
price: $0.05 per 100 words (Pangram 4.1); bulk text API 20% off (pricing page)
rate_limit: per-account QPS, read from /limits; 429 above it
terms: No benchmarking or publication clause found, but the Terms were read only through a page summary, not verbatim
cost_2000_texts: $400 at list price, $320 with the bulk discount

name: GPTZero
score_reading: document_classification and class_probabilities (support article)
gain: Most-cited commercial competitor; on the RAID leaderboard (0.972, vendor-submitted).
rate_limit: 30,000 requests an hour on all plans (support article)
terms: No benchmarking clause found; bars reverse engineering and automated data mining of the Site

score_reading: not verified
